name: example-old-bram
description: Old Bram's quest (NPCLoader example): bring him 3 Heartberries. Needs QuestLoader and the example NPC pack.

quests.title: Bram's Berries
quests.description:
Ah, a new face! I'm Old Bram. I wasn't standing here yesterday, was I? Never mind that.
My knees won't take me to the Herb Vendor anymore. Would you fetch me 3 Heartberries?
quests.descriptionForEnder: Lovely, lovely. These will make a fine tea. Here, for your trouble.
